def price(self, items: Sequence[LineItem]) -> Money:
    """Return the base total, applying the percent discount when quantity meets the threshold."""
    # Sum quantities across all line items
    total_qty = 0
    for item in items:
        total_qty += item.quantity

    # Compute the base total using the wrapped strategy
    base_total = self._base.price(items)

    # If below threshold or no discount, return base total
    if total_qty < self._threshold or self._percent_off == 0:
        return base_total

    # Compute discount using floor division and return reduced total
    discount_cents = base_total.cents * self._percent_off // 100
    return Money(base_total.cents - discount_cents)
